chunks: The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم heard a man announcing a lost item in the mosque, so he said: “Say to him: May Allah not return your lost item to you, for it was built for other than this.”

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this instruction
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, the place set aside for worship
key_terms.بُنِيَتْ: was built, indicating the intended purpose of the mosque
key_terms.ضَالَّةً: a lost item or missing property
key_terms.يُنْشِدُ: announcing or calling out in search of something lost

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about announcing lost items in the mosque?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that the mosque is a sacred place designated for worship and not for worldly announcements such as searching for lost property. It underscores the sanctity and proper etiquette of the mosque in the Prophetic sunnah.
